448.name: Lucario
448.flavor: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

449.name: Hippopotas
449.flavor: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

450.name: Hippowdon
450.flavor: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

451.name: Skorupi
451.flavor: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

452.name: Drapion
452.flavor: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

453.name: Croagunk
453.flavor: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

454.name: Toxicroak
454.flavor: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

455.name: Carnivine
455.flavor: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

456.name: Finneon
456.flavor: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

457.name: Lumineon
457.flavor: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

458.name: Mantyke
458.flavor: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

459.name: Snover
459.flavor: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

460.name: Abomasnow
460.flavor: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

461.name: Weavile
461.flavor: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

462.name: Magnezone
462.flavor: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

463.name: Lickilicky
463.flavor: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

464.name: Rhyperior
464.flavor: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

465.name: Tangrowth
465.flavor: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

466.name: Electivire
466.flavor: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

467.name: Magmortar
467.flavor: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

468.name: Togekiss
468.flavor: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

469.name: Yanmega
469.flavor: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

470.name: Leafeon
470.flavor: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

471.name: Glaceon
471.flavor: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

472.name: Gliscor
472.flavor: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

473.name: Mamoswine
473.flavor: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

474.name: Porygon-Z
474.flavor: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

475.name: Gallade
475.flavor: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

476.name: Probopass
476.flavor: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

477.name: Dusknoir
477.flavor: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

478.name: Froslass
478.flavor: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

479.name: Rotom
479.flavor: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

480.name: Uxie
480.flavor: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

481.name: Mesprit
481.flavor: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

482.name: Azelf
482.flavor: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

483.name: Dialga
483.flavor: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

484.name: Palkia
484.flavor: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

485.name: Heatran
485.flavor: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

486.name: Regigigas
486.flavor: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

487.name: Giratina
487.flavor: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

488.name: Cresselia
488.flavor: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

489.name: Phione
489.flavor: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

490.name: Manaphy
490.flavor: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

491.name: Darkrai
491.flavor: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

492.name: Shaymin
492.flavor: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

493.name: Arceus
493.flavor: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

494.name: Victini
494.flavor: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

495.name: Snivy
495.flavor: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

496.name: Servine
496.flavor: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

497.name: Serperior
497.flavor: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

498.name: Tepig
498.flavor: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

499.name: Pignite
499.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

500.name: Emboar
500.flavor: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

501.name: Oshawott
501.flavor: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

502.name: Dewott
502.flavor: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

503.name: Samurott
503.flavor: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

504.name: Patrat
504.flavor: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

505.name: Watchog
505.flavor: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

506.name: Lillipup
506.flavor: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

507.name: Herdier
507.flavor: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

508.name: Stoutland
508.flavor: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

509.name: Purrloin
509.flavor: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

510.name: Liepard
510.flavor: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

511.name: Pansage
511.flavor: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
